text.div: All assessments and procedures will be performed in accordance with the Schedule of Activities. Any clinically significant findings will be followed up as appropriate.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.1 Trial Assessments and Procedures Considerations

text.div: Screening assessments will include medical history, physical examination, vital signs, 12-lead ECG, and clinical laboratory tests to confirm eligibility.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.2.1 Screening Assessments and Procedures

text.div: Baseline assessments will be performed within 72 hours prior to the first dose of investigational product and will serve as the reference point for efficacy and safety evaluations.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.2.2 Baseline Assessments and Procedures

text.div: Efficacy will be assessed using the validated Primary Endpoint Scale at each scheduled visit. Secondary efficacy endpoints will also be assessed per the Schedule of Activities.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.3 Efficacy Assessments and Procedures

text.div: Safety will be assessed through adverse event monitoring, clinical laboratory tests, vital signs measurements, physical examinations, and 12-lead ECGs.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.4.2 Vital Signs

text.div: A full physical examination will be performed at screening, and targeted physical examinations will be performed at subsequent visits as clinically indicated.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.4.1 Physical Examination

text.div: Vital signs including blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate, and temperature will be measured at each visit after the participant has rested for at least 5 minutes.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.4.2 Vital Signs

text.div: A standard 12-lead ECG will be performed at screening, Day 1 (pre-dose), and at the end of treatment visit.
Clinical laboratory assessments including haematology, biochemistry, coagulation, and urinalysis will be performed at screening and at scheduled visits per the Schedule of Activities.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.4.4 Clinical Laboratory Assessments

text.div: Pregnancy testing will be performed for women of childbearing potential at screening and throughout the trial per the Schedule of Activities.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.4.5 Pregnancy Testing

text.div: Suicidal ideation and behaviour will be assessed using the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) at each visit.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.4.6 Suicidal Ideation and Behaviour Risk Monitoring

text.div: Blood samples for pharmacokinetic analysis will be collected on Day 1 and at Week 4 per the detailed PK sampling schedule.
A single blood sample for pharmacogenomic analysis will be collected at baseline. Participation in pharmacogenomic sampling is optional.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.6.1 Genetics, Genomics, Pharmacogenetics and Pharmacogenomics

text.div: Pharmacodynamic biomarker samples will be collected at screening, Day 1 (pre-dose), and Week 12.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.6.2 Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers

text.div: Other exploratory biomarker samples may be collected as specified in the Schedule of Activities and as described in the laboratory manual.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.6.3 Other Biomarkers

text.div: Anti-drug antibody samples will be collected at baseline and at the end of treatment visit.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.7 Immunogenicity Assessments

text.div: Healthcare resource utilisation data including hospitalisations and outpatient visits will be collected at each scheduled visit.

coding.display: ICH M11 Protocol Section 8.8 Medical Resource Utilisation and Health Economics
